title: Verify and Save can block for minutes with no duration hint and no way to cancel
outcome:
Raising the enablement doctor deadline means a single Verify can now block for up to five minutes where it previously capped at five seconds, and Save repeats the same audit - so a healthy large store costs roughly four minutes of modal-blocked UI across Verify plus Save.

Measured context: the audit on the migrated store took 122.441 s; the deadline is 300 s.

Nothing bounds the wait: handleVerify in ui/src/EngramProjectSettingsPanel.tsx awaits verifyProjectEngramSettings with no AbortSignal, ui/src/api.ts sets no client-side fetch timeout, and the server has no TimeoutLayer. The panel shows only a static 'Verifying...' label. Buttons are correctly disabled while busy, so requests do not stack from this panel - but a user who assumes a hang and reloads leaves a five-minute spawn_blocking task running.

Fix direction: say so in the label or button ('this can take several minutes on large stores') and/or wire an AbortController so the wait can be cancelled. Raised by the Claude reviewer of the deadline change.
